create.title: Demeter--Wu hyperbolic-paraboloid decoupling source interface
create.statement_tex: Demeter--Wu arXiv:2505.09037v2 is audited from the official TeX source. Definition 1.2 requires |xi_1-xi_2| asymp 1 and |eta_1-eta_2| asymp 1 for every pair of points in the two patches. Definition 1.3 and Theorem 1.6 assume Fourier support in an R^(-1)-neighborhood of two transverse hyperbolic-paraboloid patches and bound the global bilinear L2 square by a product of positive L4 cap-square sums at R^(-1/2) cap scale, up to R^epsilon. Definition 1.9 and Theorem 1.10 assume scale-R wave packets and a union X of disjoint R^(1/2)-balls with per-ball tube-incidence parameters, and again conclude a positive refined bilinear norm inequality. Linear Theorem 2.4 and pointwise Proposition 4.11 retain horizontal and vertical ruling rectangles in positive terms. The source states no prescribed-centre arithmetic exponential-sum theorem, no owner-preserving factorization of a joint pair coefficient, and no signed estimate for the retained ruling term.
create.next_action: Use only after a literal map supplies both-coordinate transverse patches, Fourier thickness, cap and ball normalization, coefficient ownership, and a separately priced ruling term. Do not cite curvature or a positive square function as fixed-centre signed cancellation.

create.title: Exact top-shell hyperbolic ruling-coordinate chart
create.statement_tex: For a top-shell ray r=(a,b), set xi=b/D, eta=-Da/(Lb), and zeta=-a/L. Then zeta=xi eta exactly. For r'=(a',b'), n=ab'-a'b>0, and P_i=cL/(kappa_iD), the reciprocal phase difference equals P_i(eta_(r')-eta_r), with eta_(r')-eta_r=Dn/(Lbb'). Hence P_i asymp Y^(32/48), while the determinant taper confines the difference to h_* asymp kappa_iD/(WL)=Y^(-5/48+o(1)). On a dyadic h-band, after localizing absolute eta, the recentered affine map X=xi-xi_0, H=(eta-eta_0)/h, Z=(zeta-eta_0xi-xi_0eta+xi_0eta_0)/h again satisfies Z=XH and changes the reciprocal evaluation scale to R_h=P_ih; at h=h_* this is c/W=Y^(27/48+o(1)). These are exact surface and physical dual-coordinate identities, not a source-radius or estimate. A widest-band broad pair must satisfy |b-b'|/D asymp 1 and Wn/(kappa_i bb') asymp 1 on sufficiently small patches. Same-denominator pairs remain exact xi-rulings.
create.next_action: Any analytic use must add absolute-strip localization, Fourier thickening, cap and spatial normalization, Jacobians, owner-preserving coefficient realization, and a separate ruling estimate.

create.title: Direct hyperbolic-decoupling applicability obstruction
create.statement_tex: Demeter--Wu Theorems 1.6 and 1.10 do not directly bound the literal Round-131 prescribed-centre top-shell scalar. In the bounded whole-shell chart the determinant support is eta-narrow, so nonzero Hessian does not imply the source's two-coordinate transversality. A recentered determinant-band zoom can create geometrically broad patches, but the physical pair coefficient B_i(r,r') remains joint through the lift selector, variable primitive moduli, Mobius/Stieltjes profiles, thresholds, taper, stars, aliases, cells, signs, and owners. The source starts with two independent functions and supplies no affordable owner-preserving projective decomposition of this matrix. Row or SVD decomposition gives an uncontrolled positive energy. For an already-factorized product, an elementary fixed-Fourier-support kernel yields only the positive Demeter--Wu cap square function with no negative power. Same-denominator packets remain exact rulings, and the source narrow machinery retains them in positive rectangle norms without a signed arithmetic estimate. Thus the current direct source interface gives no complete saving below Y^(27/48), while the best complete upper-capacity ledger remains Y^(35/48). This is a scoped method and coefficient-interface no-go, not a lower bound and not a prohibition on a new determinant-band or narrow arithmetic theorem.
create.next_action: Park direct Demeter--Wu import. Reopen only with a proved owner-preserving projective coefficient bound plus Fourier/cap normalization and a separately priced signed ruling theorem.

The source requires both-coordinate separation for every point of the two patches; same-denominator pairs additionally have exact zero xi-separation.
The shell has absolute eta of constant size. A determinant-band zoom first requires absolute eta-strip localization and the recentered hyperbolic shear.

c/W is the exact widest-band reciprocal evaluation scale only; source applicability additionally requires Fourier thickness, Euclidean-neighborhood transport, cap and ball scales, Jacobians, and coefficient realization.
A fixed-point reproducing kernel is available only for an already-factorized normalized product and leaves positive cap norms; the source does not identify or price the literal scalar.
The physical coefficient depends jointly on both rays and all variable moduli and owners. Row and SVD decompositions have uncontrolled positive projective or nuclear cost.
The source right side is positive and coefficient-blind after factorization; it does not preserve the actual Vaaler, character, Mobius, threshold, or owner cancellation.
Exact ruling and narrow pieces remain, and the best available complete upper-capacity ledger remains Y^(35/48) even if the geometrically broad contribution is granted for free.

Every packet contributing at the prescribed centre meets its centre ball, so the relevant local incidence is positive and uncontrolled; the theorem supplies no automatic smallness or negative power.
Average occupancy does not control the ruling-aligned worst cap, whose arithmetic occupancy can grow by a fixed power.
